title: DevScholar
description:
DevScholar JupyterLab Extension Settings.

If DevScholar is useful to you, please star the project on GitHub: https://github.com/pallaprolus/devscholar-jupyter (Help menu > DevScholar on GitHub).

highlightPapers.title: Highlight Paper References
highlightPapers.description: Underline and highlight paper references in cells

showTooltips.title: Show Hover Tooltips
showTooltips.description: Show paper metadata when hovering over references

parseCodeCells.title: Parse Code Cells
parseCodeCells.description: Look for paper references in code cell comments

parseMarkdownCells.title: Parse Markdown Cells
parseMarkdownCells.description: Look for paper references in markdown cells

showPaperCount.title: Show Paper Count
showPaperCount.description: Show paper count badge on cells with references

semanticScholarApiKey.title: Semantic Scholar API Key
semanticScholarApiKey.description: Optional. With a free key from https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api arXiv references also show citation counts and venue. Without a key Semantic Scholar rate-limits browser requests, so it is not used.
